body: Identical-context twin: the very same sentence occurs again later.
note: worst case for quote recovery - prefix and suffix both match the twin

body: Distinct-context twin: the quote survives in a different sentence.
note: the surviving affixes (an / record) are ordinary language, not identity evidence

body: Block-head anchor with a unique quote.
note: replacement shares exactly one leading character with the quote

body: Block-head anchor replaced by a much shorter unrelated word.
note: replacement shares one leading and one trailing character

body: One-sided twin: another block repeats the quote with the same following words.
note: the suffix agreement alone would satisfy the relaxed one-affix rule

body: Mid-block anchor with a unique quote.
note: replacement shares a five-character prefix with the quote
